title: Obi-Wan's gift
description: After rescuing Luke Skywalker from Tusken Raiders and evaluating Princess Leia's holographic plea for help, Ben (Obi-Wan) Kenobi proceeded to take the young Tatooine farm boy into his confidence. He explained about Jedi Knights and the galaxy-wide Clone Wars, then bestowed upon Luke a remarkable weapon that once belonged to Skywalker's heroic father. The Lightsaber, with an elegant blade of blue light, would serve fledgling warrior Luke well in upcoming battles.
